       2 instrument, 3 search, 4 describe, 5 status, 6 snapshot, 7 feed.

    <field name="priceCutoffMs" id="6" type="uint64" offset="12"/>
    <group name="grants" id="7" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="1">
      <field name="quality" id="8" type="uint8" offset="0"/>
      <data name="package" id="9" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <data name="key" id="10" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <data name="contractFingerprint" id="11" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    <!-- Complete KeyfiguresSearchQuery frame, empty for other actions. -->
    <data name="searchQuerySbe" id="12" type="varDataEncoding"/>
  </message>
  <message name="KeyfiguresResult" id="2" blockLength="0">
    <data name="resultJson" id="1" type="varDataEncoding"/>

  <message name="KeyfiguresSearchQuery" id="3" blockLength="13">

    <field name="budget" id="3" type="uint32" offset="8"/>

    <field name="presence" id="4" type="uint8" offset="12"/>
    <group name="filters" id="5" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
      <group name="values" id="6" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
        <data name="value" id="7" type="varDataEncoding"/>
      </group>
      <data name="name" id="8" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <group name="facets" id="9" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
      <data name="name" id="10" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <group name="keys" id="11" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="0">
      <data name="key" id="12" type="varDataEncoding"/>
    </group>
    <group name="ranges" id="13" dimensionType="largeGroupSizeEncoding" blockLength="49">
      <!-- bits 0..3: gt, ge, lt, le present. -->
